itemDisplayName: Azure SQL Hyperscale database with a named replica
description: Deploy an Entra-only Azure SQL logical server, a provisioned Hyperscale primary database, an independently sized read-only named replica on the same server, and a single-client IP firewall rule. Both databases use 2 vCores by default and have no additional high-availability replicas.
summary: Deploy a Hyperscale primary and an independently sized read-only named replica with Microsoft Entra-only authentication.
